traps: Saying magnetic field lines start at the north pole and end at the south pole
Claiming magnetic field lines are always straight lines
Stating magnetic field lines exist only inside a magnet
Suggesting magnetic field lines can intersect
Equating magnetic field lines with electric field lines

checks.ask: Does the answer state that magnetic field lines form closed loops (they have no start or end)?
checks.claim: Magnetic field lines form closed loops.

checks.ask: Does the answer state that magnetic field lines never intersect each other?
Does the answer state that the density of magnetic field lines indicates the strength of the magnetic field?
checks.claim: The density of magnetic field lines indicates field strength.
